items.source: Each TypeFilter will be instantiated using an appropriate constructor, with BeanClassLoaderAware, BeanFactoryAware, EnvironmentAware, and ResourceLoaderAware contracts invoked if they are implemented by the type filter.
items.translation: 每个 `TypeFilter` 都将使用适当的构造函数进行实例化，如果该类型过滤器实现了 `BeanClassLoaderAware`、`BeanFactoryAware`、`EnvironmentAware` 和 `ResourceLoaderAware` 接口，则会调用相应的契约。

items.source: Create type filters from the supplied AnnotationAttributes, such as those sourced from ComponentScan.includeFilters() or ComponentScan.excludeFilters().
items.translation: 从提供的 `AnnotationAttributes` 创建 `type filters`，例如源自 `ComponentScan.includeFilters()` 或 `ComponentScan.excludeFilters()` 的那些。

items.source: filterAttributes - AnnotationAttributes for a @Filter declaration
items.translation: `filterAttributes` - `AnnotationAttributes` 用于声明一个 @Filter

items.source: registry - the BeanDefinitionRegistry to make available to filters as a BeanFactory if applicable
items.translation: registry - 向过滤器提供的 BeanDefinitionRegistry，如果适用的话，则作为 BeanFactory

items.source: environment - the Environment to make available to filters
resourceLoader - the ResourceLoader to make available to filters
a list of instantiated and configured type filters
items.translation: 已实例化并配置的类型过滤器列表

items.source: Collection of utilities for working with @ComponentScan type filters.
items.translation: 用于处理 `@ComponentScan` 的实用工具集合，以及 `类型过滤器。
